question: Who inaugurated the Water Transversality Global Awards & Conclave 2026 in New Delhi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shri Om Birla.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Shri Om Birla, the Hon’ble Speaker of the Lok Sabha, inaugurated the Water Transversality Global Awards & Conclave 2026 in New Delhi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Core Concept:** The event focused on **"transversality,"** an integrated approach to managing the interconnected sectors of Water, Energy, Health, and Environment.
 
• **Organizer:** The conclave was organized by the **India Water Foundation (IWF)** in collaboration with **UN ESCAP**.
 
• **Commemoration:** A **Special Postal Stamp Cover** was released by India Post to mark 18 years of service by the India Water Foundation.
 
• **Awardees:** The event honored 49 individuals, including the Chief Ministers of **Maharashtra** (Devendra Fadnavis) and **Meghalaya** (Conrad K. Sangma).
 
• **Participation:** Shri Raj Bhushan Chaudhary, Minister of State for Jal Shakti, also participated in sessions regarding **ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• UN ESCAP__

 __
 
• The United Nations Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific, headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
 
 
 
• Jal Shakti Ministry__
 
 
• Formed in 2019 by merging the Ministry of Water Resources, River Development & Ganga Rejuvenation and the Ministry of Drinking Water and Sanitation.
